授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
Topic: Fundamental Inorganic Chemistry
Time: Tuesdays 13:00
WATCH THE VIDEO ON GROUP PROJECT WORK BEFORE THE FIRST LECTURE (SEE MOODLE).
This course might be subject to change at any point. Students MUST stay up to date with announcements from Moodle.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
1.	Understand, use and explain the periodic table.
2.	Understand, use and explain different molecular theories.
3.	Understand the relationships and properties of the d-block metals.
4.	Understand basic chemical thermodynamics, including Gibbs Free Energy.
5.	Understand basic concepts of chemical kinetics.
6.	Understand basic concepts of chemical equilibria.
7.	Understand basic concepts of electrochemistry.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: Must have passed Basic Chemistry or similar level course.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.授業への貢献度:
Students will be marked based on a combination of presentation marks and personal demonstration of knowledge in the questions session. Marks MAY be adjusted based on peer feedback.
1) Their group performance in project presentations, and
2) Their personal performance in project presentations, and
3) Possibly based on feedback questionnaires from their group.
Scores will be averaged over the seven projects.
